tei:div.tei:p: (ma)༄༅// dpal sa ra ha'i bstod pa sogs bstod pa dang tshogs brjod 'ga' zhig bzhugs// swasti/ dpal sa ra ha la bstod pa/ shākya'i rgyal po'i gdung 'tshob pa// rgyal sras sgra gcan zin nyid las// rab byung bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin// rig byed nas byung rig pa'i gnas// ma lus mthar phyin thub pa yi// bstan pa rdzogs par 'dzin nus pa// dge slong gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin// chen por gyur nas yun ring du// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin mdzad pa// khyod ni ston pa gnyis pa mchog /klu sgrub kyi yang bla mar gyur// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan 'di la// sngags la zhugs nas grub pa'i sa// brnyes pa kun gyi thog mar ni// gyur pa yin zhes kun la grags// de nas mdo dang sngags kyi ni// gzhung rtsom mdzad po phal che ba'i// srol phye bstan bcos brtsom mdzad pa// kun gyi yang ni thog mar gyur// de nas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i gnas// phyag rgya chen po'i sar bzhugs pa// skye dang 'chi ba mi ston zhing*// gshegs dang bzhugs rtsom mi mnga' yang*// rig pa 'dzin dang mkha' la spyod// gang du yang ni khyod bzhugs shing*// gnas gzhan gang du'ang khyod 'byon pas// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas bsam mi khyab// bstan pa 'di la nges pa'i don// thos dang bsam pas gsal mdzad pa// klu sgrub thogs med kyis phye ba'i// shing rta'i srol gnyis byon ji bzhin// bsgom pas nyams su len pa'i tshul// grub pa dang ni snying po'i skor// rnam pa gnyis zhes mang la grags// sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu mchog /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum gyis// rim pas rgyas btab shes rab can// gzhung rtsom byed po 'ga' yis kyang*// dbye bar ma nus man ngag gi /lde mig mang po'i 'phrul 'khor las// gsal bar phye nas mngon sum du// ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams dang skye mched ces// mngon pa'i chos su gang grags pa// ma gtogs yul gzhan yod min par// thag chod byas pa'i skad cig la// rnam shes tshogs bdun 'khor dang bcas// yul gang la yang 'phro min par// nang du bsdus pa'i dus de nas// sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu mthong*// de mthong mod la long ba yi// phyag dar khrod nas de rnyed ltar// mi 'bral mchog tu gces bzung bas// skad cig de la chos kyi dbyings// mtha' yod min pa'i shes bya la// khyab par mthong ba'i man ngag kun// gsal mdzad dpal ldan sa ra ha// spyan zur bsgrims nas rang gi sems// mda' snyug lta bur srong ba yi// gar mdzad rang gi ye shes las// gzhan pa'i chos 'ga' med gzigs pa// de tshe ji lta ji snyed kyi// chos kun bde ba chen por ni// ro gcig gyur pas sngags kun la// thags thogs med par myur du ni// 'jug pa'i man ngag ston mdzad pa// 'jigs med sa ra ha khyod kyis// chos kun ngo bo'i stong pa dang*// rgyu yi mtshan ma med pa dang*// 'bras bur smon med sgo gsum po// mgyogs par phye bas ye shes kyi// rang zhal mthong ba de tshe ni// chos dang gang zag tu rmongs pa'i// go skabs 'jug pa ma yin te// rnam thar sgo gsum rim bzhin du// 'byed pa sngon du song phyir ro// de 'dra tshegs chen yun ring pos// rdzogs pa'i sbyor ba go gyur nas// rtog bral nyid kyi mnyam gzhag las// langs pa'i de ma thag rjes su// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis// ngo sprod pas na rmongs las grol// ma dag snang yul phyi rol rgya mtsho che// de mthong rnam shes gser gyi ri bdun po// thams cad 'dzin med ye shes rol pa'i mtsho// ro gcig ston mdzad dpal ldan sa ra ha// stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mda' gcig gis// rnam shes 'dus pa'i lha min dpung gi tshogs// mtha' dag mun pa'i gnas su gnyal zin pas// ye shes dpag bsam 'dod 'jo 'di na dge

/zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// swasti/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhabs la bstod pa/ 'jigs med chos skyong zhabs ni nā len+d+ra// kā ma shrī la'i gtsug lag khang chen por// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i mtsho chen bsrung mkhas pa// gnas brtan 'dul 'dzin bsnyengs pa kun dang bral// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' ni// yang yang brgal bas gnyis med ye shes mchog /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor rang dbang 'jug mdzad pa// shes bya'i gnas 'dir rmongs pa med khyod kyis// klu sgrub rigs pa'i gzhung la thag gcod mkhan// ār+ya de ba'i srol chen de bzung nas// ji snyed rigs pas dpyad pa'i don po ni// ji lta'i ye shes nam yang 'dor mi mdzad// thal rang dbu ma'i srol lam mi rtsi bar// rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbu ma der zhugs nas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i sgrub pa yun ring du// rang rgyud sbyangs shing smin pa'i skad cig la// rje btsun yab dang gnyis med shes rab kyi// pha rol phyin ma'i tshul bzung lnga phrag gis// lhag pa'i bcu phrag 'khor dang lhan cig tu// mngon par dbang bskur mdzad pa'i skad cig la// phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub de brnyes nas// sngon sbyangs bsod nams tshogs kyi mthu grub pas// 'bad rtsol med par sa drug dbang phyug tu// skad cig de la gyur khyod phyag gi gnas// srid pa'i rtse mo lan brgyar brgal khyod kyi// nyi ma bzung dang gaṅgā gyen bzlog la// dpyod ldan mkhas pas ngo mtshar bya mi dgos// 'di kun nyon mongs las kyi bdag po'i 'bras// cir snang sems su zhen pa'i grangs can pa// phyi rol don la rmongs pa khegs bags yang*// ri dang rwa ba chu chen la sogs la// thogs med 'gro ba'i rdzu 'phrul yod min nam// 'khor ba'i chu chen gyen du bzlog pa dang*// nang gi nyi ma rang sar 'dzin nus pa'i// rtags 'ga' phyi rol yul la ston nus pa// 'ga' zhig yod na de la phyag bgyi'o// lha chen dgas dang mu stegs bcings tsam gyis// dpyod ldan mkhas pa ngo mtshar bya mi dgos// 'di dag rmongs pa'i lam du bying zin la// zhe sdang lha chen lan brgyar dgas pa dang*// rmongs pa'i mu stegs mthar byed phyag zhabs kyi// stangs dang stabs kha 'dzin nus 'ga' mchis na// de la sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o// ma dag snang ba 'khrul par ston mdzad mkhan// ma rig 'khrul 'khor 'jig par thag gcod mkhan// myang 'das 'khor lo rtag par ston mdzad mkhan// 'khor bas stong dang bde ba mi stong zhes// e waṃ zung 'jug rgyud du thag gcod mkhan// waṃ yig rdo rje rnam gsum bde ba che// 'jig rten lus las 'das par 'chad mdzad mkhan// kun rdzob rang rang gis stong 'gyur med e// kun khyab stong pa nyid du thag gcod mkhan// waṃ yig bcom ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje ni// e yig chos dbyings dag pa'i khang bzang du// zung 'jug bco lnga'i tshogs dang dbyer med par// rol mdzad rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa// khyod la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// bdag blo 'khor ba'i 'dam du mi 'jug cing*// myang 'das zhi ba'i skam la ma chags par// zung 'jug dgyes pa rdo rje bdag gyur cig

/ces bya ba 'di yang dpal shākya mchog ldan gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ //rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i rtogs brjod// ༄// na maḥgu ru bh+yeḥ shing rta chen po'i grags thob pa// 'jigs med dpal ldan chos skyong ni// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas// byin brlabs gyur pa'i dus de nas// dbu ma par gyur sa drug gi /rtogs pa mngon du mdzad pas na// rnam rig srol las 'das so zhes// rnam par thar pa 'chad rnams gsungs// dbu ma'i tshul de gang yin zhes// dris tshe phyis byung lam 'bras pa// gzhan zer dbyangs su len pa rnams// thal rang gzhung du des zhugs zer// 'dis mdzad man ngag gzhung lugs ni// thal rang lugs dang mthun ma yin// lta ba ngo bo nyid med las// lhag ces gsung zhing de gzhung gis// lta ba rtogs pa min zhes dang*// lugs der rnam grangs ma yin pa'i// don dam bshad pa med ces dang*// lugs de'i thos bsam shes pa yis// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i lta ba de// dug can nyid du gsal bar gsungs// thal rang gzhung du chos kyi dbyings// med par dgag pa kho na dang*// gnyis med rang rig rang gsal dang*// snang ba sems sogs rigs pas bkag /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag gi /lam gyi gzhung shes de dag las// rim pa bzhin du ldog nas gsungs// slob dpon zla ba grags pas ni// chos skyong grub pa thob rjes su// thal 'gyur lugs kyi stong nyid ni// 'jigs nas spangs pa yin zhes dang*// ye shes snying pos chos skyong ni// shing rta chen po nyid gyur kyang*// bden gnyis rnam 'byed rmongs zhes pa// bshad zin de la bsams pa yin// 'o na dbu ma gang zhe na// sngags kyi dbu ma kho na ste// skal bzang sngags su zhugs tsam nas// dbu ma nyid du nges phyir ro// sngags kyi dbu ma zhes bya ba'i// rnam gzhag bshad pa med ce na// spros bral rtogs pa'i thabs la ni// gsang sngags khyad par 'phags gyur na// de rtogs pa de grub pa'i mtha'// smra ba lnga pa zhig yin nam// rgyud du lta ba rim 'jug tshe// ngo bo nyid med smra ba las// gong du dgyes pa rdo rje la// 'jug par bshad pa ma yin nam// lta ba lhan cig skyes ye shes// pha rol phyin las mi rnyed pa// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa las// rnyed ces dang ni 'phags pa lhas// chos kun rmi lam sgyu 'dra zhes// sangs rgyas pa kun smra mod kyi// zhes sogs gsungs phyir gsang sngags kyi// dbu ma kho na dbu ma che// rje btsun grags pas ljon shing du// thog mar sngags kyi lta ba bstan// de nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi

/man ngag lugs kyi rim pa'o// rnam rig pa dag gsang sngags la// 'jug tshe thal rang lugs mi dgos// rang gzhung nyid nas der zhugs tshe// sngon gyi lta ngan 'dor dgos med// gnyis med ye shes bden grub pa// lugs der yod pas 'dor zhe na// de ma bkag kyang der 'dzin pa// 'gog pa lugs der yod pas chog /gnyis med ye shes gang zag gi /bdag tu rmongs pa zlog pa'i phyir// brtag pa gnyis par gang zag gi /bdag med thog ma nyid du bstan// chos kyi bdag med rgyas pa ni// thal rang gzhung la rag ce na// man ngag gzhung 'dir sems las gzhan// med par thag chod sems nyid kyang*// 'dzin pa med par thag bcad pas// chos bdag lhag mar lus pa med// de tsam zhig ni thal rang gi /gzhung la ltos pa ma yin par// lam 'bras dang ni spros med kyi// man ngag nyid las legs par grub// rnal 'byor dbang phyug klu sgrub gzhung*// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i srol bzhin du// bkral la 'gyod pa mi mnga' bzhin// rdo rje theg pa'i rtse mor byon// zhes pa rdo ring kun spangs pa'i// chos tshan bco lnga'i thog ma ste// ne'u thog gi bla ma 'ga'// lam 'bras gsung ba'i phyag tu'ang phul// //bha wan+tu// ༈ //grub chen lū dril nag gsum gyi rtogs brjod// ༄// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nag po spyod pa ni// 'phags yul shar phyogs bhaṅga lar 'khrungs nas// grub pa mchog brnyes dzā lan+dha ri la// nges par bsten mdzad bde mchog 'khor lo yi// dbang bskur rgyud dang gdams pa ma lus gsan// rigs par bsgrubs pas lta stangs rnam bzhi grub// de nas 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbus shig tu// spyod pa spyad nas grol bar zhal gyis bzhes// dus der dzā lan+dha ra'i zhal mnga' nas// lta stangs rnam bzhis tshar gcod nus gyur kyang*// de grol byed pa'i rjes 'dzin mi nus pas// da dung spyod pa'i dus la mi bab gsung*// bla ma la ni u rgyan mkha' 'gro mas// byin rlabs mkha' la 'gro dang mngon shes sogs// thogs med 'char ba'i rgyan drug gang stsal ba// de nyid bdag la stsol na spyod pa yi// yul du nges par rgyu zhes rings par chas// de bi ko ṭa ma gtogs yul chen du// rigs par rgyu ba'i gnang ba bla mas stsal// de nas rnal 'byor ldan pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs// gnyis kyis lhag pa'i bdun cu dang bcas pa// khru gang tsam gyis sa la ma reg pa'i// gom pas 'gro zhing 'dzin po med pa yi// gdugs bdun mdun gyi mkha' la rigs par 'gro// 'khrol byed med pa'i ḍā ma ru bdun po// rang sgra sgrog pa'i chas kyis rnam par rgyu// de nas shar phyogs bhaṅga lar chas pa// gaṅgā'i 'gram du mnyan pos ma bsgral tshe// na bza' gting nas chu bo'i pha rol byon// skabs der mdze can chu la sgrol zer ba// de la rme ba'i 'du shes skyed byas shing*// chu bor ma bying mngon pa'i nga rgyal mdzad// gang de'i 'khor gyi nang na yod pa yi// dge tshul zhig gis mdze mo khur ba na// gaṅgā'i dkyil nas mkha' la spyod par song*// grub pa'i dbang phyug tshem bu pa zhes grags// de nas rmos kyi glang dang shing thog la// blta stangs grub kyang sgrol bar ma nus shing*// klog mkhan zhig gis klog pa'i glegs bam gyi// yi ge'i cha yang mkhyen par ma gyur to// de nas shar phyogs bhaṅga lar byon nas// rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba dang*// blon po dge ba'i mgon po gnyis// phyi rol pa dang nang pa'o// blon pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang na// spyan ras gzigs dbang lha chen gyi// gzugs su byas pa'i rab gnas zhus// spyi bor me tog bcings nas ni// su pra tiṣ+ṭha zhes tsam brjod// de la blon po ma mgu nas// nag po spyod pas lha rten gyi// me tog phog nas gshegs pa na// rten yang de yi phyi bzhin byon// de nas yid ches gsol btab pas// sku gzugs lam de nyid du bzhugs// sngon gyi gnas der ma bgrod pas// lam de nyid du lha khang brtsigs// blon pos 'khor lo sdom pa yi// dbang bskur zhus nas ras bris kyang*// rgyas par bris nas gsang bar gdams// de nas rgyal po phrag dog gis// 'jigs byed dus mtshan kha sbyor gyis// bde mchog yab yum mnan pa yi// ras bris bzhengs nas nus pa 'gran// zer ba slob dpon gyis gsan nas// bcom ldan 'das la gsol btab nas// tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i tshe// 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal bstan nas// cung zad spyod pa ma ran pas// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi 'grub phyir// gzhung drug rtsoms shig bar do ru// mchog grub ces pa'i lung bstan mdzad// de nas zhag bdun lon pa na// rgyal po'i bris sku go log nas// 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan pa yi// bcom ldan yab yum gsal bar byon// de nas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas// shin tu dad nas rgyal srid phul// dbang dang gdams pa ma lus zhus// bhaṅga la pa'i mi rnams kun// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyid du gyur// de nas bla ma'i bka' bcag nas// de bi ko ṭa'i yul du byon// skyems nas bud med gzhon nu la// shing thogs blangs bas ma ster bar// phrogs nas zos pas khrag tu 'khrus// de la cis phan dris pa na// rgya mtsho'i wu bas phan zhes zer// slob ma rkang mgyogs grub pa yis// de blangs 'ongs pa'i lam bar na// slob dpon grongs pa yin zer nas// bud med bdun tsam ngu ba mthong*// 'o na sman gyis ci bya zhes// chu la pho nas 'ongs pa na// slob dpon ma grongs zhal mnga' nas// de ni mkha' 'gro'i bar chad de// bla ma'i bka' las 'das pas lan// tshe 'dir phyag chen mi thob pas// bar dor lus 'di la zhugs nas// sangs rgyas mngon du byed pas na// lus 'di zhag bdun bar du zhog

/ces gsungs nag po spyod pa yi// rnam par thar ba mdo tsam ste// rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal mnga' nas// bla ma'i bka' bcag spyod pa mdzad// nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa yi don yin no// sngon gyi mdze mo phag mo ste// zhing rmod klog mkhan he ru ka /shing thogs bsrung ba'i bu mo ni// snying po'i rnal 'byor ma gcig zhes// he ru ka yi slob dpon la// lung bstan mdzad pa de yin no// slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa// shar phyogs rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs// rgyal srid snying po med gzigs nas// dpal ldan nā len+d+rar gshegs te// rgyal ba'i lha las rab tu byung*// mtshan ni blo gros snying po'i dpal// rig pa'i gnas rnams mthar phyin nas// yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// bstan pa rgyal du gtsugs pa yi// rtsod pas mu stegs pham mdzad pa'i// mtshan ni dgra las rnam rgyal zhes// sa chen gsum du rnam par grags// de nas dā ri ka pa dang*// mjal nas 'khor lo sdom pa zhus// dben pa'i gnas su bsgrubs pa na// u rgyan yul chen der song shig /phag rdzi mo yis rjes 'dzin zhes// mkha' las lung bstan byung ba thos// de nas der song phag rdzi mo// der yid ches la rjes 'dzin zhus// de nas de yis mkha' 'gro ma'i// rang gzugs bstan nas dbang bskur te// lho phyogs yul du sgoms shig ces// lung bstan thob nas lho phyogs kyi// o ḍi bi sha zhes bya ba'i// yul gyi nags khrod nyams dga' bar// sgrub pa snying po mdzad pa'i tshe// yul de'i rgyal po sos ka'i dus// nags der rtse zhing rgyu ba na// dge slong lus rid 'tsho ba yis// phongs pa mthong nas snying rje yis// grong khyer dag tu 'dong zhes smras// slob dpon gyis ni phyag rgya yi// dngos grub 'grub par nges gzigs nas// lan du khyad gsod tshig 'di smras// dngos po'i rang bzhin yod nges pa'i// mkhas la khyod kyis brnyas mi bya// rtsa rtse'i bcud pa chung ba yi// 'byor pas mkhas rnams 'khyig mi nus// rgyun mi chad par chang 'dzags pas// 'gram lhang nag por gyur pa yi// glang chen rnams ni pad+ma yi// skud pa phra mos 'khyig mi nus// de skad rgyal po de khros nas// ngas 'dir grong khyer dbus shig tu// smra phab gyis zhes dril bsgrags so// de tshe chang tshong ma zhig gi

/bu mo rab mdzes gzhon nu ma// pad+ma can gyi rig gyur pa// de yis don de khas blangs so// de la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams// rgyal pos pho brang nang nas byin// bu mos nags su slob dpon gyi// lhan gcig gnas par khas blangs pa// skal ba ldan par gzigs nas gnang*// dbang bskur dam tshig ldan byas nas// rim pa lnga pa mthar phyin pa// ji srid lo grangs bcu gnyis bar// phyag rgya dang bcas sgrub pa mdzad// de nas kun tu bzang po yi// spyod pas o ḍi bi sha na// gnas pa mtha' dag tshul chen la// bzud par bzhed dang dus mtshungs par// rgyal pos chang 'tshong ma la springs// de ring nags nas dge slong de// grong khyer dbus su bos shig ces// srang gi bar dang mdo rnams su// chang gi bum pa rim par sgrigs// chang 'tshong ma yi bu mo la// slob dpon spyan 'dren 'phrin du springs// sprul pa'i bu dang bu mo gnyis// rigs par sprul nas g.yas g.yon du// rgyug par byed cing slob dpon gyis// rwa yi gshor du zhal bcug pa// jo mos chang gi bum pa rnams// rim par btegs nas gsol bzhin byon// grong khyer dbus su slebs pa na// rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yis// sngon tshe slob dpon gyis smras pa'i// glu de blangs nas khyad gsod byed// rgyal pos drangs tshe mi 'ongs par// chang 'tshong ma yi bu mo yis// ci dgar khrid pa 'di mtshar zhes// thal mo rdebs shing bzhad sgra 'byin// de nas dngos grub brnyes pa des// rwa yi gshor zhal sa la rdabs// sa 'og rim pa bdun phug nas// 'og gi chu chen gyen du 'phyur// chu yi dbus nas spyan ras gzigs// thugs rje chen po'i sku zhig 'khrungs// chu rnams de la lan bdun du// skor bar byas nas sa 'og song*// sku de deng sang bar du yang*// 'gro ba skyob pa'i dpal du gnas// dus der slob dpon rang nyid ni// he ru ka yi gzugs su bsgyur// btsun mo rdo rje phag mo dang*// sprul pa'i bu ni rdo rjer byas// bu mo dril bu nyid gyur te// bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yi// rnam par byas nas mkha' la gshegs// rdo rje dril bu ba zhes par// rab tu grags pa de yis ni// gdul bya mkhas pa'i don slad du// rang bzhin gyis grub dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur cho ga de sgrub thabs// rim pa lnga pa rnams mdzad do// rdo rje gdan pa'i zhal mnga' nas// bu rmad bcas shing dngos grub brnyes// rdo rje'i dril bu pa zhes pa'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa yang 'di yin no// lū hi pa zhes nyi ma ltar grags pa// u rgyan yul du grags thob yi ge pa'i// rigs 'khrungs kun tu dga' bar mtshan gsol ba// ri khrod dbang phyug nyid kyis rjes su bzung*// bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur rgyud bshad gdams pa gnang*// sgrub la brtsod mdzad dus gcig tshe// dur khrod gnas su phyin pa na// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// dam tshig rdzas shig byin pa na// the tshom med par zos pa las// sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas/

zhugs shing rdzogs par dbang mnos pas// dpe yi ye shes nyams su myong*// don gyi ye shes rtogs bya'i phyir// bskul ba'i tshig 'di mkha' la grags// rkang pa brkyang ba spangs nas ni// 'khor ba'i mngag gzhug dor nas su// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// yang dang yang du bskul bar bya// zhes pa gsal bar thos nas ni// rtse gcig sgrub par mdzad dgongs te// 'tsho ba gang la rten snyam nas// chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du byon// nya lto tshegs chung btsal sla bar// dgongs nas phyogs der sgrub pa mdzad// phyag rgya chen po mchog grub pa// de tshe zas la mtshan gsol ba// lū hi pa zhes rnam par grags// de nas rgya gar lho phyogs kyi// rgyal po bi ma la tsan+t+ra// 'dul ba'i dus la bab gzigs pa// de tshe de yi skyed tshal gyi// dbus na rin po che yi khri// legs bshams phyogs rnams 'dod pa yi// yon tan ma tshang med rdzogs pa// brgya byin yul gyi dgos rgu rnams// sa la 'phos 'dra der byon nas// rgyal po dpung tshogs ma 'ongs pa'i// mngon du slob dpon smyon pa yi// cha byad gzugs kyis khri stengs bzhugs// mnyam par bzhag las g.yo med tshe// rgyal po'i mdun nas sngar 'ongs pa'i// bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa rnams// rab thogs shis brjod tshangs pa'i bu// mdun na 'don rnams der 'ongs nas// smyon pa phar song ha ha zhes// khros nas bzhad sgra ngor byed tshe// slob dpon mnyam gzhag las bzhengs te// bram ze rnams la sdigs mdzub kyi// phyag rgya mdzad nas 'di skad ces// ma lus sa 'di ji tsam yin// 'jig rten gsum po'ang ji tsam yin// de yi cha nyid ji tsam pa// mi bdag de yi g.yogs yin na// gzhan gyi dam pa'i spyod pa la// blo bzang bzhad gad byed pa ni// e ma 'khor ba ngo mtshar che// 'di la smra ba mang ci dgos// zhes gsungs bram ze skyengs nas log /de nas rgyal po de khros nas// dpung tshogs kun gyis smyon pa'i gzugs// de rlag byos zhes song ba na// slob dpon gyis ni sdang mig gis// bltas nas ha ha hi hi zhes// bzhad pas dpung tshogs kun smyo nas// ha ha zer zhing phyogs bcur bros// de nas rgyal po de skrag nas// maṇ+ḍal phul nas bzod pa gsol// rgyal pos rnal 'byor pa khyod su// slob dpon gyis kyang khyod su zhes// smras pas rgyal pos nga rgyal po// slob dpon gyis kyang nga rgyal po// rgyal pos smras pa slob dpon la// rgyal po'i longs spyod ci yod dris// sa gzhi mal stan chen po ste// lag pa'i blo rten 'bol ba khri// zla ba'i 'od zer sgron ma gsal// bsil g.yab rjes su mthun pa'i rlung*// gnam sngon yangs pa bla re ste// chags bral stong pa'i bud med la// ci bder spyod deng rgyal po ltar// 'jigs med bder nyal rnal 'byor pa// zhes gsungs rgyal po de dad nas// glang po'i mchog gi bshul stengs nas// khab tu spyan drangs dbang bskur zhus// rgyal srid spong bar khas blangs pas// bde mchog 'khor lo'i dbang bzhi bskur// dpe yi ye shes nyams su myong*// de'i blon po'ang der dad nas// dbang bskur bde chen nyams su myong*// de nas rgyal blon gnyis ka la// phyag rgya chen po'i don ston par// bzhed nas gang la sems 'phro dris// rgyal po smad 'tshong ma la ste// blon po'i ḍiṅgi'i sgra la zer// ḍiṅgi'i sgra las brtsams nas ni// skye 'jig gnas gsum rtog bcug pas// gang du yang ni ma rnyed pa// chos kun de bzhin shes byas pas// phyag chen ye shes mngon du byas// de nas rgyal blon de gnyis kyi// don du sgrub thabs gzhung de mdzad// de nas rgyal pos rgyal srid kyi// cha gcig dge sbyong bram ze la// gcig ni phongs pa rnams la sbyin// gcig ni rgyal srid 'dzin la gzhag

/gcer bur lus phyung thal bas byugs// 'doms ras dkris shing slong phor thogs// lho phyogs yul gyi rgyud shig na// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// smad 'tshong ma yi cha byad 'dzin// bcu gnyis lo bar de bsnyen na// bud med stong phrag bcu bzhi dang*// bcas pas mchog gi don grub ces// lū hi pa yis de lung bstan// blon po de yang de bzhin du// chang 'tshong ma la bsnyen byas na// bcu gnyis lo nas yul khams de'i// mi dang byol song thams cad kyis// mkha' spyod dngos grub thob ces gsungs// de nas de bzhin mngon gyur pa'i// mtshan ni dā ri ka pa zhes// rab grags 'khor lo sdom pa yi// bstod pa la sogs gzhung rnams mdzad// dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pas kyang*// rgyal rigs tha mal spyod pa mdzad// smad 'tshong lnga brgya mkha' la gshegs// dā ri ka pa zhes bya ba'i// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsung blon po de yis kyang*// de bzhin grub pa mngon gyur tshe// slob dpon ḍiṅgi pa zhes grags// rdo rje gdan pas bstod pa las// 'bras bu spyod cing dngos grub brnyes// ḍiṅgi pa zhes bya ba yi// bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa yang yin no// ༈ //mdo sngags kyi nges don gsal bar mdzad pa'i slob dpon rnams kyi khungs// ༄// swasti/ mnyam par bzhag cing bdud btul nas// byang chub shing drung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs byams pa// gzugs kyi skur bzhengs mi pham mgon// ji bzhin gzigs pas 'phags gyur pa// ji snyed 'chad la thogs pa med// dam chos kun gyi dbyig ji snyed// 'dzin pa'i mdzod dang skyong mdzad gnyen// rgyal ba'i lung bstan shes rab mtshan// mthar gnas blo ldan bzang po'o// grub pa'i sar bzhugs rig gnas lnga// yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇa chen no// nyid kyis bshams pa'i chos kyi khrir// sher phyin gsungs mdzad ston pa nyid// 'phags lam 'chad la 'khrul med par// rgyal bas bsngags pa rab 'byor nyid// mthong ba'i spang bya'i sgrib pa las// rnam grol 'phags pa sde snod 'dzin// dngos smra'i glang chen 'jigs med yang*// skrag mdzad seng ge bzang po nyid// bod 'bangs kun gyi jo bo rje// phul byung a ti sha'i mtshan// 'jig rten mig gcig rin chen bzang*// mdo rgyud bstan pa'i sgron mar grags// thub pa nyid kyi chos khri nas// chos 'chad mdzad po mi pham mgon// rdo rje'i gnas bdun ji bzhin pa// gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos bkral// bram ze rin chen rdo rje zhes// 'phags pa'i yul du grags dkar thob// de dbon skye bo dam pa zhes// grags pas byams pa nyid la nos// lo tsā chen po'i chos kyi mdzod// ma lus 'dzin mdzad gro lung pa// rgya chen chos kyi nags khrod du// 'jigs med seng ge rgyu zhing gnas// dam chos mngon pa'i mdzod bzung nas// ston mdzad blo gros brtan par grags// rtsod ldan dus su thams cad mkhyen// gnyis par grags pa'i shān+ti pa// mi pham byams pa'i thugs mtsho las// nges par 'khrungs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal// des sras shākya rgyal mtshan dpal// phrin las bzang pos bstan pa bzung*// don dam chos mkhas yod smra'i sde// btsun mdzad gdul bya'i dpal bzang po// shākya'i bstan la rnam kun gyi// mchog ldan nges pa'i don 'chad mkhas// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i ye shes kun// gzugs kyi skur bzhengs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// shin tu spros med zhi ba yi// spyod pas sngags kyi lha grub pa// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs ye shes kyi// rtse mor mi thub zla ba byon// rdo rje 'chang dbang yid bzhin mtshor// grags pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan por tshugs// slar yang byang chub shing drung du// byon pa ma hā bo dhi nyid// thub chen ston pa gzhan kun las// 'phags bstod mdzad po dngos grub rje// thub sku rdo rje'i gdan nyid du// rang byon mdzad pa bde byed dga'// rdzogs sangs rgyas dngos bstod pa yin// bsgrub mdzad rgyal po dga' ba'i lha// rgyal yum blo 'das brjod med pa// thabs mkhas gzugs skur bzheng khyod nyid// 'jam pa'i dpal khyod kun gyi ni// snying la dbyangs can dga' mdzad do// rig gnas kun dang grub pa'i sar// 'jigs med gdeng thob dpa' bo'i sku// yid kyis shing rtas legs ldan pa// 'byed cing 'joms mdzad 'phags pa'i sras// bden pa bzhi po'i chos 'khor nas// dbu mar 'jug mdzad thub pa nyid// rang gzhung tshugs dang gzhan 'joms la// klu dang srid sgrub de mtshungs mtshan// ye shes nyid la gang shar ba// rang gi snying po gang 'dis mkhyen// sgyu ma rigs sgrub mkhyen pa'i dpal// mi gnas snas pa yang 'dis mkhyen// kun rmongs chags sdang zhi ba'i tshe// dgu brgya go dgu'i lor bzhugs pa// bod khams chos min pham mdzad nas// pad+ma'i ngang tshul du bzhugs dge

/sgrub pos ring du mi thogs par// mngon sum zhal ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bstan pa 'di la dbu ma yi// srol 'byed dang po klu yi mtshan// rigs tshogs lta ba rang rgyud kyis// 'grel mdzad thog ma legs ldan 'byed// thal 'gyur gzhung lugs thog mar ni// 'dzugs mdzad sangs rgyas dgongs skyong pa// rtags dang rigs shes rim can pas// mtshan 'dzin sel mdzad blo ldan bzang*// gangs can ljongs su thal 'gyur gzhung*// dang por 'dzugs mdzad nyi ma grags// chos 'khor bar mtha'i lta ba nyid// klu dang srid sgrub mtshungs 'chad mkhan// 'phags pa'i nyams myong rnal 'byor spyod// sngags kyi lha dang mtshungs 'chad mkhan// 'phags lhas rjes bzung dpa' bo ni// kun la 'jigs med rta dbyangs so// klu las gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro mas// byang chub brnyes pa'i mtshan ldan no// mtha' bral ba dang zung 'jug gi /dbu ma dag ston sa skya pa// mtha' bral med dgag 'ba' zhig pas// byang chub mdzad la brtson 'grus pa// dpal ldan zung 'jug sku brnyes pa'i// sprul sku ye shes 'byung gnas so// zla ba'i legs bshad 'od dkar gyis// gsal mdzad 'phags pa'i dgongs par grags// don dam yod med spros pa'i mtha'// kun las grol ba'i dpal mnga' nyid// shākya'i bstan pa 'chi med mdzod// mchog dang thun mong kun tshang ldan// dman pa'i sa dang bdud bzhi po// 'joms mdzad bcom ldan mi g.yo mgon// spyan ras gzigs dbang sangs rgyas kun// skrun mdzad yum gyi bkra shis spyon// shu bhaṃ// ༈ //'gro la thugs rje phul byung a ti sha'i dpag yas yon tan phul byung bsngags pa'o// ༄// na mo bud+dha ya/ sngon tshe mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don slad du// byang chub thugs mchog bskyed pa'i mthu grub pas// dus 'dir kun gyi gtsug na lham me ba// jo bo'i mtshan ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo// nges pa'i don du rgyal ba 'od dpag med// drang ba'i don du rgyal sras bzang po skyong*// yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta// sprul pas 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal srid spangs nas legs gsung 'dul ba la// rab tu byung zhing phal chen sder zhugs te// gtsug lag khang chen du ma'i bdag por gyur// gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i gnas dang rgya che'i chos rnams la// bslab sbyangs mthar phyin theg mchog rtse mo yis// rang nyid grol nas 'gro mang smin mdzad pa// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes la mgos phyag 'tshal// bshad bya'i bka' rnams byang zhing chub pa'i sku// 'chad byed gzhung la thogs pa med pa'i gsung*// rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i thugs// yid bzhin nor bur gyur la mgos phyag 'tshal// nyams len byin brlabs rgyud pa ma nyams shing*// zab mo lta ba'i gru chen de bzung nas// rgya chen spyod pa'i phyogs la rtag 'grus pas// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dbang por mgos phyag 'tshal// a ti sha zhes snyan grags gser gyi rnga// gangs can 'gro ba'i snying la bde ster mkhan// yum mchog sgrol mas lung bstan ji bzhin du// snying rjes bod khams bskyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// chu pho rta nas shing pho rta yi bar// bcu gsum lor bzhugs skyes bu rnam gsum gyi// lam gyi rim pas 'gro kun gong nas gong*// 'dren mdzad ston pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor mang bsdu dang gsung rab bsgyur ba dang*// gzhung rtsom byed dang legs par bshad pa dang*// skyo ngal bzod dang lhug par gtong ba yis// 'gro don 'ba' zhig dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo// bu slob nying slob chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las kyis// bstan pa gnas dang sems can don kho na// lhag par dgongs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nges pa'i don du spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs// drang ba'i don du bshes gnyen ston pa'i sku// 'od dpag med pa'i phrin las sgrub pa'i gsung*// 'gro ba'i dpal du shar la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon tshe bod kyi lha gcig btsan po'i sku// bar du bla chen dgongs pa gsal ba'i gsungs// phyi ma'i dus su 'brom ston thugs rje can// 'phags mas lung bstan brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal// bshes gnyen zhang las dge bsnyen sdom pa mnos// se btsun sogs la pha rol phyin gzhung sbyangs// rgya gar paṇa chen zhal las brda sprod dang*// sgra bsgyur mthar phyin mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// shing mo lugs la rwa sgreng zhes grags pa// dben pa'i nags su bka' gdams zhes bya ba'i// chos tshul bla na med pa de btsugs nas// bshad sgrub rgyun mi chad la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar dwang bas phyag 'tshal rnam dkar gyis// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i nyi ma ni// 'jig rten khams su lan brgyar gsal ba dang*// bka' gdams bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad shog

/byang chub sems dang brlabs chen spyod pa yis// sems can ma lus mgron du gnyer ba dang*// mtha' yas sems can mgu byed bgyis pa yis// rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams mnyes gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni snar thang gi ston dpon shes rab bzang po pas/ gsol ba btab pa'i ngor bgyis nas/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo yis so// //shu bhaṃ// ༄༅// na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/ dpal ldan a ti sha sras dang brgyud par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i phreng ba spel legs zhes bya ba/ 'chi med dbang po rgyal ba 'od mtha' yas// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug rigs gsum mgon// rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro ba'i don slad du// gangs can ljongs 'dir byon la mgos phyag 'tshal// phul byung a ti sha zhes snyan grags pa// a wa dhū tī kun spangs drang srong che// dī paṃ ka ra mar me mdzad ye shes// shra ma ṇa zhes dge sbyong chen po'i mtshan// gang khyod chu pho rta la shar phyogs yul// sa hor rgyal po dge ba'i dpal zhes pa// rgya nag stong khun rgyal po'i 'byor pa yang*// zil gnon byed de'i sras 'khrungs zla ba'i snying*// gzhon nu nyid nas yi dam mngon sum gzigs// srid la ma chags dge ba'i bshes gnyen btsal// ri nag khongs su gsang ba'i rdo rje las// dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dbang dang gdams pa mnos// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon ni// a wa dhū tīr grags dang lhan cig tu// lo bdun rgyu zhing rig pa brtul zhugs kyi// spyod pa lo gsum spyad pas grol bar gyur// de nas u rgyan yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma// rnams dang lhan cig tshogs la spyod pa na// rdo rje'i glu mang gsan zhing yi ger btab// de nyid bod du 'gyur ba kun la grags// de ltar grub pa mchog la gnas pa'i tshe// bcom ldan nyan thos 'khor bcas gsungs gcig gis// lung bstan brnyes nas rang lo nyer dgu'i tshe// phal chen sde las rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs// mkhas btsun tshogs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por// rig pa'i gnas dang sde snod phal cher mkhyen// snyan pa'i grags thob kun gyi dri ba'i yul// de nas rim gyis gnas brtan chen por gyur// gang des chos kun gsan pa'i bla ma ni// dz+nyā na shrī dang ku sa li chung ba// dzā+ai tā ri dang nag po zhabs chen po// ḍom+bi ba dang rig pa'i khu byug zhabs// nā ro pa dang dz+nyā na bo dhi'i mtshan// a wa dhū tī byang chub bzang po dang*// chos kun shes pa'i paṇa chen shān+ti pa// gser gling pa las byang chub thugs mchog brnyes// gzhan yang bla ma dharma rak+ṣi ta// bye brag smra ba'i paṇa chen de las kyang*// bstan bcos bye brag bshad mtsho bcu gnyis lor// sbyangs pa phul phyin mkhas pa'i grags dkar brnyes// de ltar gsang sngags chos lugs grub pa dang*// rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la mkhas pa dang*// gnas brtan go 'phangs bzung nas btsun pa dang*// byang chub thugs mchog brnyes la mgos phyag 'tshal// bod kyi lha gcig btsan po byang chub 'od// gang gi snyan pas yid rab drangs gyur nas// bod 'bangs yongs la thugs brtse'i don slad du// spyan 'dren pho nyar tshul khrims rgyal ba mngags// re gcig bzhes pa chu pho rta lo la// bal yul skyid grong la sogs rim brgyud nas// bod 'bangs yongs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor// nyams dgar gyur nas chos kyi char chen phab// nang du bla med theg pa'i smin grol dang*// phyi rol skyes bu gsum po'i lam rim gyis// sngon byung chos log mang po sun phyung zhing*// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gnas rnams gsal bar mdzad// rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i nyams len gcig dril ba// gsang sngags 'phrul gyi me long zhes bya dang*// mdo dang sngags kyi bstan bcos thun mong ba// byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'ang der mdzad cing*// de 'grel nyid kyis mdzad par grags pa dang*// 'khor lo bar pa'i lta ba gzhir bzung nas// gser gling rgyal po'i don du bden pa gnyis// zla grags gzhung la 'jug pa de mdzad do// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje'i sprul pa ni// chos tshul bgrang yas mkhyen pa ston pa'i mtshan// jo bo'i mtshan tsam thos pas yid rangs te// mdo khams yul nas byang gi lam brgyud bar// chos skyong sprul pas shul gyi sna drangs te// rje nyid gang du bzhugs pa'i sa yi cha// pu hrangs yul du shing mo bya la mjal// de nas 'brom gyis dpal ldan a ti sha

/dge 'dun gsung la sangs rgyas bka' bzhin du// gces par 'dzin pa'i bka' bstsal rnyed pa na// dbus kyi sde chen rnams su mchid shog springs// sngon gyi ban chen ye shes blo gros dang*// mkhas btsun chen po legs pa'i shes rab dang*// rgyal gyi ka ba sogs kyi ming phyung bas// khu ston ma bzod sngon du spyan 'dren brtsams// de nas sde pa mang po'i bdag gyur pa// khu ston la sogs kun gyis sna drangs pa'i// ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams ngang pa yi// khyu mchog dbang pos ngang pa'i tshogs khrid bzhin// tshul khrims rgyal bas dpal ldan mar me mdzad// rgya gar yul du skyel bar chas pa'i sa// dpal thang zhes bya'i gnas su 'dus shing mjal// lo tsā dbugs phyung dbus kyi yul du chas// rtsang gi shul rings mgyogs par bgrod nas ni// rong gi yul du dpal ldan mgar dge dang*// yol ston chos dbang jo mo sgre mo sogs// skal ldan 'ga' yi don mdzad dngos grub thob// shul rings mgron po pha ma rgas pa dang*// nad pa'i zhabs tog byas dang stong pa nyid// thun gcig sgom pa bsod nams mnyam mo zhes// cung zad 'tsho bas phongs pa'i gtam yang mdzad// byang thang yul nas lha sa'i nam mkha' la// lha tshogs mchod pa 'bul ba spyan gyis gzigs// chos 'khor bsam yas bstan pa'i gzhir mkhyen nas// yang yang bsngags pa brjod cing rings par mdzad// 'ching rung bag la chas pa'i bu mo yis// mgo rgyan phul nas tshe yi dus byas pa// de don ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga yis// 'dod lhar skyes pa lha yi mig gis gzigs// dol gyi ljongs su jo bo gcig pu la// dbul pos bsod snyoms drangs pas phyug por gyur// khu ston nan gyis thang chen gnas su phebs// zla gcig lon tshe 'brom gyis spyan sngar slebs// gnas der thugs ma chags pas dbu yi zhwa// byin rlabs rten du byin nas 'byon par brtsams// lha btsun po dhi rā dzas bsam yas su// mgyogs par spyan drangs bod ston phal cher 'dus// bstan bcos mang po'i 'gyur dang zhus chen mdzad// 'brom gyis snye thang zhes grags bang ston gyi// gtsug lag khang der gus pas spyan drangs te// lo dgu'i bar du bde bar bag phebs so// skabs der rngog gis lha sar spyan drangs che// spyan ras gzigs kyis brag sgo'i gnas nas bsu// mkha' 'gros gter yig gtad nas lha sa yi// lha dang gnas kyi nges pa ji bzhin rnyed// rtog ge 'bar ba'i 'gyur dang zhus chen dang*// dbu ma'i man ngag che chung gnyis kyang mdzad// byang chub 'byung gnas zhes grags rngog ston gyis// yer par spyan drangs dam chos mang du gsungs// rgyal gyi ka ba shākya dbang phyug gis// 'phan yul lan pa spyil bor spyan drangs nas// dam pa'i chos gsungs rta mgrin sgrub pa mdzad// 'byung po btul nas sa phyogs byin gyis brlabs// tshul khrims rgyal ba rang gi yul btang nas// dga' ldan gnas su lhan cig dus btab mdzad// jo bo gshegs kar kho bo'i bris sku la// dge bar spyod nas rab gnas mdzod ces zhus// gung thang lo tsā lcags mo phag lo pa// so gnyis pa la jo bo spyan 'drongs nas// gzhan yang nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang*// shan+ti bha dra sogs kyi lo tsā mdzad// de ltar bod khams mang po'i bde skyid dang*// bod yul dbus kyi skyes chen phal che ba// lha gcig btsan po nyid dang nag tso yi// bka' drin las byung gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'od dpag med mgon dpal ldan a ti sha

/bdag tu bzung ba'i zham ring gnyug ma pa// spyan ras gzigs sprul ston pa rin po che// bstan pa'i bdag por gsol zhing skyabs gsum gyi// rten gyur ji snyed mchis pa 'brom nyid la// dge bar gtad nas bstan pa skyongs shig dang*// kho bos rtag par byin gyis rlob bo zhes// lung bstan dbugs dbyung mdzad nas shing pho rta// ston zla 'bring po'i yar tshes bco lnga la// dga' ldan gshegs nas zla gcig dus dag tu// gser gyi me tog char chen 'dab brgyad pa// grangs med stsal ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras gyur yul dbus su// khu rngog 'brom gsum gtsang nas 'gar 'gos yol// mnga' ris lo tsā rin chen bzang po dang*// lha btsun byang chub 'od dang nag tso sogs// so sor bgos pa'i gdung skal thob pa la// dngul gyi gdung khang gzi brjid 'od 'bar ba// dngul gdugs can zhes grags pa re re mdzad// rang rang yul du sa phyogs byin gyis brlabs// shing mo lug la ka bas snye thang du// jo bo'i yi dam rje btsun sgrol ma dang*// nyid kyi lhungs bzed mkhar gsil sogs bzhugs pa'i// gtsug lag khang chen brtsigs nas chos 'khor mdzad// de ltar jo bo'i mdzad pa mthar phyin nas// jo bo'i bskyangs pa'i tshogs pa ji snyed pa// 'brom rje ston pas ji ltar bskyangs pa'i tshul// mdo tsam brjod pa gus pas mnyan par bgyi// 'brom ni jo bo'i rang lo nyer bzhi pa// shing mo sprul la stod lung phur 'khrungs nas// rgyal gyi zhang chen rdo rje dbang phyug la// dge bsnyen mnos pa'i mtshan ni chos 'phel zhes// de nas khams su se btsun zhes grags pa// kun gyi dri ba'i yul gyur che de'i drung*// nye bar bsnyen nas dam pa'i chos mang gsan// mkhas pa gzhan las lo tsā legs par sbyangs// da lta rgya gar yul na su che zhes// kun la dris pas mar me mdzad dpal zhes// mtshan tsam thos pas dad pa'i spu langs shing*// tshe 'dir mjal ba'i go skabs srid dam zhes// mol mchid yang yang gleng ba'i skabs shig na// bod rje btsan pos jo bo spyan drangs zhes// thos pa'i mod la don gnyer bung ba'i tshogs// yid 'ong pad+mo'i tshal du bsnyeg pa bzhin// bod rje'i bsrung mas lam gyi sna drangs te// u pa si kas dus 'dir slebs so zhes// sgrol mas lung bstan mdzad pa'i tshes grangs la// jo bo'i drung du bar chad med par slebs// de ma thag tu smin byed dbang bskur nas// lo bcu'i bar du ljon shing grib ma bzhin// nye bar bsnyen pas rgyal ba'i bka' mtha' dag

/ma lus gdams par 'char ba de thob bo// shing mo lug la 'phrang kha ber chung gis// 'brom ston rwa sgreng gnas su spyan drangs nas// lo bcu'i bar du 'gro mang smin par mdzad// gzhon nu rgyal mtshan zhes grags phu chung ba// bden bzhi'i rnam pa mi rtag pa sogs kyis// smin par gyur nas byang chub spyod pa'i phyogs// dben par nyams len mdzad la g.yel mi mnga'// rin chen gsal zhes grags pa'i po to bas// 'brom gyis mkhyen pa'i dam chos ji snyed pa// legs par mkhyen nas rang nyid grol ba dang*// 'gro mang smin pa'i phrin las bsam mi khyab// nyin re bzhin yang 'brom gyi spyan snga las// gzhan du ma 'das spyan snga'i mtshan thogs pa// tshul khrims 'bar la jo bo'i gsang sngags kyi// gdams pa ma lus gnang zhing bsgoms mdzad dang*// jo bo bod du byon lo sne'u zur pa// ting 'dzin rang chas mnga' ba'i ye shes 'bar// gang 'khrungs bdun cu rtsa gnyis lor 'tsho ba// 'brom dang po to ba las bka' gdams mnos// gdams ngag pa zhes grags pa'i bka' gdams pa// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin chad pa med de byung*// po to ba ni jo bo'i zhe brgyad pa// lcags mo lug la spras kyi sar 'khrungs nas// rgyal gyi glan la rab tu byung mdzad nas// nyer brgyad lo la 'brom gyi drung du byon// de nas rang lo lnga bcu lon gyi bar// rtse gcig sgrub las g.yel ba mdzad mi mnga'// lnga bcu gcig nas bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar// tshogs pa bskyangs ba'i phrin las bsam mi khyab// de sras skyes bu dam pa bgrang yas las// thugs rje rang dang mnyam pa'i glang thang pa// rdo rje seng ger grags pa jo bo rje// dga' ldan gshegs pa'i shing pho rta lo la// sgra ris gnas su 'khrungs nas bdun bcu'i bar// bslab sbyangs gzhan don mdzad pa bsam mi khyab// rdo rje gdan pas khyung po rnal 'byor la// 'od dpag med pa'i sprul par lung bstan nas// rab byung bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po zhus// glang thang ba des tshe rabs thams cad du// dge slong dngos po dag dang mi 'bral ba'i// dam bca' brtan po mdzad tshe dpal lha mo// lhang lhang gre'u'i skad bcas der byon nas// de yi bar du khyod kyi grogs bya gsung*// glang thang pa de gshegs pa'i 'og rol tu// tshogs pa phal cher shar ba pa la 'dus// mnyam med dwags po'i bla ma lcags ri pa// byang chub dpal zhes grags pa mdo khams nas// gzhon nu'i dus su 'byung pos gzir ba zhig

tshong pa'i rjes 'brangs khyi yi rnam par byung*// glang ri thang pas ting 'dzin mthu bstan pas// 'byung po bskrad nas rjes bzung smin par mdzad// sha bo sgang pa pad+ma byang chub ni// glang ri thang pas rang lo bcu bzhi pa// me mo lug la 'khrungs pa nas bzung ste// re lnga'i bar du byang chub sems sbyangs nas// stong phrag tshogs pas bskor ba'i bshes gnyen yang*// glang ri thang pas rjes bzung slob mar grags// glang thang pa la tshogs pa nyis stong tsam// 'dus pa'i nang nas yar lung lcags zhing pa// gzhan yang ba yags 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang*// lung lung mo pa mdo sder grags pa dang*// zhang btsun gnyan dang zhang zhung pa la sogs// yongs kyi bshes gnyen dam pa mang zhig byung*// glang thang zhang gis gdan sa mdzad pa na// bshes gnyen phag mo grub pas gnas der btugs// glang thang pa dang nyi zla zung gcig tu// rnam par grags pa'i zhang btsun shar ba pa// yon tan grags pa'i mtshan can jo bo rje// gshegs nas bcu bdun lon pa lcags khyi la// 'khrungs nas bshes gnyen dam pa po to ba'i// spyan sngar rab byung gdams pa ma lus gsan// mkhyen rab yangs pa'i mthar phyin rgyal ba'i bka'// 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams thugs la bzhugs par grags// tshogs pa sum stong drug brgya 'dus pa la// bshad pa phal cher gzhung chen nyid la mdzad// pa tshab lo tsās zla ba grags pa'i gzhung*// mang zhig bsgyur ba spel ba'i grogs mdzad nas// thal 'gyur gzhung mchog nyin mor byed pa yang*// gsal bar grags pa bshes gnyen gang de'i mthu// bshes gnyen dam pa mtshan mo'i skar ma tsam// smin par mdzad nas bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa// zhi bar gshegs so bu chen nyi zla ltar// rnam par grags pa snar thang gtum ston dang*// 'chad kha'i bya ston ye shes rdo rje gnyis// 'chad kha ba ni 'khrungs yul lo ro ba// sha mi'i drung du 'dul ba gsan pa na// lcags zhing pa las glang ri thang pa yi// tshigs bcad brgyad ma'i tshig 'ga' gsan pa na// dwang ba thob nas dbu ru'i phyogs su byon// shar ba pa la gdams pa de gsan nas// lo grangs bcu gsum nyams khrid bskyangs pa las// ji bzhin thugs la 'khrungs nas don bdun ma// yi ger bris pa'i gdams pa de nas byung*// gtum ston blo gros grags la shar ba pas// dge slong bzhi sde re dang lhan cig tu// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i zhal chems gsungs pa las// lcags mo bya lo bshes gnyen shar ba pa// gshegs pa'i lo nas chu pho spre lo'i bar// nges med gnas kyi nang chan so so bar// rang nyid smin dang 'khor tshogs grol mdzad pa'i// phrin las mdzad tshe 'khor mang 'dus pa na// chu mo bya la dpal ldan snar thang btab// lo grangs bcu bzhir tshogs par bskyangs mdzad nas// bshes gnyen dam pa gser ri'i phreng ba ltar// rnam par grags pa rim par brgyud pa las// thub bstan yid bzhin rin chen ma nyams pa// bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod mdzad pa'i// shes rab grags dang bdud rtsi grags la sogs// bshes gnyen dam pa rnams ni phyag bya'i 'os// jo bo bod du byon nas shar ba pa// gshegs pa'i bar la lo grangs brgya song zhing*// de nas snar thang ma btab gong rol du// bcu gnyis lo lon btab nas rin po che// grub pa shes rab yan chod lo yi grangs// nyis brgya re lnga song ba me mo bya// de nas drug cu skor gcig 'das pas kyang*// lo dgu lon pa deng sang shing mo sbrul// de ltar jo bo bod du byon pa nas// deng sang yan la bzhi brgya bzhi bcu dang*// lo bzhi lon pa shing mo sbrul gyi bar// phyi dar bstan pa nyin mo ji bzhin du// mnyal zhig slob ma dkyel nag grags seng gis// snar thang gnas su phar tshad bshad grwa btsugs// skyi ston grags 'bum zhes dang chu mig pa// seng ge dpal sogs mkhas pa mang du thon// bcom ldan ral grir grags pa'i mkhas pa ni// yar lung phu thang du 'khrungs bsam yas kyi// mchod rten dkar po'i sde la rab tu byung*/

chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes byar mtshan gsol ba// dga' ba gdong du dbyar nyi brtson 'grus la// phar phyin gsan tshe sa nad rtog pa yis// snar thang skyo ston drung du phyag rdor gyi// gdams pa zhu bar bsam nas chas pa las// snar thang rgya sgo'i them par zhabs bzhag tshe// tshogs dung bus dang dbu la nyi shar ba// mnyam du byung bas rten 'brel bzang bar dgongs// rnam nges stong tshar bshar bas sa nad thon// grwa der sde bdun sbyangs shing mi g.yo ba'i// bsnyen pa dung phyur bcu gsum mdzad pa las// shes rab nam langs rnam dpyod nyi ma shar// gsung rab kun la 'jigs med spobs pa brnyes// rgya gar paṇa chen 'ga' la chos mang gsan// gya lnga'i bar du 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yis// gangs can ljongs kyi sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs// phal cher 'dus nas rtsod bral mkhas par grags// rtsom pa'i rnam grangs lnga brgyar grags pa las// bstan pa rgyas mdzad ces bya'i bstan bcos su// bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams kyi// tshad dang 'gyur byang brjod bya'i ston tshul mdzad// de'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs sgeg po zhes// snyan par grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po de// sa skyar bzhugs tshe hor gyi spyan drangs nas// thub bstan dgongs pa'i lhag bsam rnam dkar bas// bka' dang bstan bcos ji snyed 'gyur ba rnams// ma lus bzhengs pa'i yo byad tshogs phul bas// gang de'i slob ma dbus pa blo gsal ni// byang chub ye shes zhes byar grags pa dang*// stag ston lo tsā bsod nams 'od zer dang*// sde snod 'dzin pa byang chub 'bum rnams kyis// 'bad pa chen po'i phyi mo kun btsal nas// mkhas mang 'du ba'i grwa chen snar thang du// 'jam dbyangs lha khang zhes byar mtshan btags pa// sngon med bstan pa'i gtsug lag khang chen mdzad// de nas kun mkhyen gnyis pa rin chen grub// bu ston lo tsā grags pa'i rtsod bral ba// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa'i rnam 'phrul des// phyi mo'i go rim slar yang bsgrigs pa dang*// sngon mas ma rnyed chos tshan stong phrag tsam// gsar du bsnan pa'i zhus chen dam pa mdzad// gangs can ljongs su bka' dang bstan bcos kyi// glegs bam ma nyams sgron ma 'bar ba yis// ston pa'i bstan pa nyin mor ltar gsal ba'i// bka' drin mtshungs med gang las byung gyur pa// bcom ldan ral gri brgyud par bcas pa dang*// mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu ston lo tsā yi// legs mdzad kun la nges par yi ring zhing*// sgo gsum kun nas gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo lung bstan brnyes pa'i chos kyi grwa// bka' gdams sde chen dpal ldan snar thang du// brgyud pa'i rim pa gzhan las 'ongs gyur pa'i// chos kun 'dus pa'i nang gi rol mtsho ni// yi dam zhal gzigs kun la ma rmongs pa'i// skyes chen dam pa nam mkha' grags pa'i zhabs// mdo sngags nang gi don dang rig pa'i gnas// mtha' dag 'dus pa bcom ldan ral gri'i zhabs// slar yang sngon bzhin skyes bu rnam gsum gyi// bstan pa'i rim pa ma tshang med de dang*// tshul chen sngags dang sgra tshad la sogs pa// rig gnas kun gyi mtsho chen khengs par shog

/spyan ras gzigs dbang mtshan mo'i nyi ma yis// gangs can ut+pal bzhad pa'i dga' ba la// lta 'dod 'od dpag med pa'i nyi ma ni// bod yul dbang po'i lam du bde bar byon// khyab gsal shing rta 'dren pa'i kha lo pas// nyin byed shar nas shar du 'dren de bzhin// bod khams nub kyi ljongs su rol rtsed mkhan// 'brom rje dad pa'i pho nyas shar du drangs// 'brom ston thugs rje'i zla bas byang phyogs kyi// thub bstan pad mo phyogs brgyar bzhed pa ni// lha cig mkhyen pa'i nyi ma snying rje yi// zla bar sim pa'i dpal yon lags par grang*/ mkha' la nyi ma lan brgyar 'char mdzad kyi// byed po de dag kun gyis ya mtshan na// sa la bstan pa'i nyi ma mi gzugs can// stong phrag brgya pa'i byed po 'di ci zhig /lha gcig gzugs kyi ya mtshan kho na yis// gangs can nyin mor byas pa ma yin gyi// de gsung snang ba ma nyams de srid du// phan bde'i 'dab brgya bzhad par gdon mi 'tshal// tshangs pa'i bu mo na gzhon khrus kyi dag byed mkhan de sa stengs 'dir 'ongs bzhin// mkha' yi zla ba bsil zer can gang 'dir byon min nam tsha gdung sel de ci// srong btsan thugs rje'i zla ba chos dbyings zhi ba'i mkha' la ring du gnas gyur mod// ma dros mtsho las gaṅgā'i klung bzhin bsil mdzad rkyong ba 'di ni 'brom gyi mtshan// pad dkar bzhad pa'i dga' bas nyer tshim nas// gling gzhan mdza' bo blta ba'i zur mig ma// 'dzam gling 'dab brgya'i tshal la chags bzhin du// shar ri'i rtse nas 'dzum mdangs gsal ba ltar// mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla zhing gzhan gshegs de dag /skal bzang rgyu skar phreng ba'i do shal can// rnyog bral lang tshos khengs pa'i sngo sangs ma// phan bder byed pa'i mig tu 'bar byed shog /skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar ro brgya pa// don gnyer bung ba smra mkhas dar dir can// dgyes mdzad pad dkar phreng ba 'di 'bul gyi// shes rab bzang po'i nyi mas de long shig

/smig rgyu rlabs phreng ltar brgyus pas// yid bzhin rgya mtshor mtshon mi nus// legs mdzad kun la yi rang ba'i// phreng mdzes 'dzin pa rgya mtsho 'dra// bab col smra la lce bde bas// smra mkhas dbang por su yis rtsi// dam pa'i rnam thar brjod mkhas pa// chen po'i gral du dbu 'phangs mtho// rkang brkyang la gnas bre mo'i gtam// smra mkhas mdzangs pa'i grwar mi brin// ngo mtshar can gyi gtam sna gcig /brjod mkhas de dag mang pos bkur// mang pos bkur ba 'jig rten gyi// chos su ma zad 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i dge ba gong nas gong*// 'phel mdzad chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyu// zhes jo bo rje lha gcig sras dang rgyud par bcas pa'i ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i phreng ba spel legs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snar thang stong dpon shes rab bzang po'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor gyis nas/ yul dbus kyi klog pa pa dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ sna tshogs dbyig ces pa shing mo sbrul gyi lo/ tha skar can gyi dga' ba dang po la nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bshes gnyen chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //'jig rten gyi mig gcig rin chen bzang po'i bstod pa/ rnyog bral yid kyi dwang ba 'dren byed ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rtag tu phan dgongs rgyal sras brtse ba can// zab mo'i don la 'khrul med mkhyen pa can// bdud dang sa gnyis gnon pa'i mthu stobs can// lhun grub rgyun mi chad pa'i phrin las can// rin thang ma nyams chos kyi char chen pos// tha gru ma nyams gangs can ljongs chen po// zab rgyas ma nyams chos kyi mtsho chen por// bskrun mdzad phrin las bzang po la phyag 'tshal// lha gcig btsun pas

ye shes 'od kyi/ mthun pa'i rkyen brgya sbyar// kha che'i yul du lan gsum byon/ dam chos sgo brgya sbyangs// sngon med theg chen chos kyi 'gyur brgya mdzad// khyod kyi sku tshe'i tshad kyang lo brgya rang lo go brgyad/ pa// skye nas skye bar rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis// rjes bzung gang 'dir rje btsun rnon po la// lan grangs so lnga me tog babs gyur pas// mkhyen rab dbang por gsol la phyag 'tshal lo// lha gcig khri srong btsan po'i sku ring la// rgya gar paṇa grub mang po'i nyi ma shar// nam zhig rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhus pa'i tshe/ mun pa'i thun mtshams gyur pa na// rin chen phrin las bzang po'i zla ba shar// theg mchog chos kyi rtse mo bla med rgyud// paṇa chen mang po'i thugs las gang 'gyur ba// gsang sngags snga 'gyur zhes bya'i lam chen gsal// blo chen du mas rig 'dzin dngos grub brnyes// de nas rim gyis 'dod lha'i zhags pa ni// gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i blo la nges zhugs nas// gzhung mang brtsams shing sngags gzhung khyab 'jug dang*// drag po'i gzhung bzhin sgrub pa mang zhig byung*// de tshe lha btsun ye shes 'od mdzad bkas// blo chen khyod kyi dpal ldan 'dus pa dang*// rnal 'byor rgyud gzhung dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i// glegs bam ma nyams gsal por spyan drangs nas// gsang sngags log par spyod pa sun 'byin pa'i// ngo mtshar bstan bcos thub bstan nor bu yi// sbyong tshul rim gsum ldan pas nges sbyangs nas// bshad bsgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor khyod kyis bkod// 'gyur dang zhus chen 'chad dang nyan pa yis// bu slob yang slob chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du// rin chen chos kyi phrin las bzang po can// khyod dang mnyam pa'i 'gyur mdzad 'ga' ma byon// rgya mtsho'i ngogs su klung chen 'bab pa bzhin// chos kyi mdzod 'dzin paṇa chen mang

shrad+dha ka ra warma/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ pad+ma ka ra/ pradz+nyā ka ra/ ka ma la gup+ta/ di paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ shar phyogs dharma pā la/ po zhig /ngang gis 'dus nas dbang dang bshad srol dang*// ma nyams glegs bam tshogs rnams khyod la gtad// theg mchog chos kyi dga' ston bla med pa// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi ya mtshan ltad mo ni// phyi ma'i dus 'dir mthong zhing longs spyod pa// brtse chen khyod nyid gcig pu'i drin kho na// zhug rim pa/ sgo gsum bsdams nas rtse gcig bsgrub pa mdzad// mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan dang*/ dge ba la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i/ chos gsum rtog pa shes bzhin skyes gyur na// sku gsum mnga' ba'i chad pas chod cig ces// mnal bro gsum 'tshal nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// rdzu 'phrul shugs thob bdud ris klu chen zhig /ba lang skyong ba'i snying la cher bzhugs pa// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba'i tshul bzung nas// chos ltar bcos pa'i sgyu 'phrul du ma yis// brtse chen ston pa'i bstan pa rim gyis bsgribs// mthu chen khyod kyis ting 'dzin stobs bskyed nas// skar rgyal zhes bya'i bstan dang ston pa ni// rlung chen shugs kyis dbang po'i gzhu bzhin du// chos dbyings zhi ba'i mal du nges par mnan// 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can ljongs dag tu// bstan 'dzin blo yi me long rnyog pa na// bstan pa'i 'gal zlar gyur pa mang byung yang*// drungs nas sun 'byin nus pa gzhan ma byung*// de phyir bstan pa sngon med gsar ma/ bsgyur ba dang*// 'gyur zin rnying ma/ bstan pa'i dri ma sel ba dang*// klu kar rgyal dang*/ sbyor sgrol chos su smra ba/ bdud dpung 'joms pa'i bka' drin mnyam med pa// stsol mdzad rin chen bzang por phyag bgyi'o// de ltar khyod kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i cha// nges par thos nas yid rab drangs gyur cing*// mngon par dga' ba gong nas gong spel bas// khyod bzhin 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig

/gzhan yang 'gos dang rngog dang pa tshab dang*// sa lo spang lo bu ston lo tsā ba// 'gyur dang zhus chen nyan bshad spel ba yi// skad gnyis smra ba rnams la rjes yi rang*// de ltar skyes chen dam pa'i rnam thar la// yid rab dwang ba'i rnam dkar ci yod pas// dam pa min pa'i ri bos gdul bya yi// gser gyi nor 'dzin gnon par ma gyur cig /ces 'jig rten gyi mig gcig rin chen bzang po'i bstod pa/ rnyog bral yid kyi dwang ba 'dren byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ gser mdog can gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rngog lo ts+tsha ba chen po sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dga' ston chen pas dad pa'i shing rta nges par drangs pa bzhugs// ༄// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs mnga' bar shin tu grags/ can// blo bzang mkhyen ldan shes bya'i gnas rab gsal// rgyal bas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang*/ mgon po mngon byung las/ lung bstan gangs can 'gro ba'i mig /phrin las bzang po'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// bod yul rmongs pa'i gnyid kyis yid 'khrugs pa// de kun thugs rje'i lam du nges drangs nas// bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i lo ts+tsha ba// blo ldan phrin las bzang por mgos phyag 'tshal// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul mkhyen pa can// mkhas btsun chen po rngog legs pa'i shes rab las/ las rab byung zhing*// bsnyen par rdzogs nas legs gsung 'dul ba dang*// rgya chen spyod pa'i phyogs kyi pha mtha' gzigs// de nas bstan dang sems can don 'ba' zhig /lhag par dgongs nas dka' spyad bgrang yas kyis// lung rigs nyi zla'i snang ba cher 'bar ba// 'phags pa'i yul nas gang 'dir khyod kyis blangs// phyogs 'dir sngon med chos kyi lam po che// rgyal ba'i yum dang byams pa'i chos lnga dang*// phyogs glang grags pa'i ring lugs zla bral ba// 'jig rten mig gcig khyod kyis

nyan bshad kyi sgo nas/ nges par bstan// deng sang 'di na lung dang rigs pa yi// shing rtas nyer blangs rang gzhung bsgrub pa dang*// gzhan gzhung 'gog pa'i tshul la blo gsal ba// de kun khyod kyi mdzad pa bzang po'i drin// blo bzang chos kyi dbyings las mi bzhengs kyang*// bu slob nying slob nyi zla'i 'khor res kyis// gangs can rmongs pa sel ba'i phrin las ni// brtse chen rgyal ba de dang nges par mnyam// kha che'i yul du sgra tshad nang*/ rig pa'i gnas gsum la// legs par sbyangs nas 'gyur dang srol 'byed rnam bshad rgyas pa/ mdzad// 'phags yul dbus su go mi 'chi med dang*/ bstan skyong sogs/ shar phyogs paṇa chen la// shes phyin chos lugs brnyes nas srol chen rnam bshad rgyas pa/ btod// rgya bal mtshams su ḍom+bi he ru kas stag la skyon nas/ mkha' la spyod pa dang*// rig 'dzin brnyes kyang bod 'bangs spyan gyis bzung*// rnam 'grel gzhan phan bzang po dang*/ skal ldan rgyal po sogs las/ mdzad gzhung rigs pa'i lam chen nas// klu sgrub lugs bzang gzigs pa khyod kho na// de nas gang tshe lo grangs bcu bdun du/ myang bstod/ bo dong*/ lha sa/ bsam yas sogs/ ru bzhi'i yul du chos kyi char chen po// rigs par phab tshe glegs bam zhal 'byed pa// khri phrag lnga dang tshogs 'chad zur chos pa// stong dang brgyad brgya brgyad cu rtsa lnga yi// ngur smrig 'tshams sprin phreng bas 'jig rten khams// nges par gang ba'i ya mtshan bltas mo ni// ston mdzad 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal ba bzhin// bod kyi yul 'dir gser kha dang*/ las sgo mang po bye zhing rgyal po dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po mang po cig car du dus der byung ba'o/ srid dang zhi ba yi// 'byor pa'i tshogs rnams mthun par 'ongs gyur pa// khyod kyis bstan pa skyong ba'i dus kho na// yin zhes kun la grags pa der phyag 'tshal// de ltar khyod kyi mdzad pa'i rgya mtsho las// cha yi cha la yi rang bgyis pa yi// dge bas bdag dang slob mar gyur pa kun// khyod bzhin 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig

/'bre yi rigs 'khrungs legs pa'i shes rab las// rab tu byung zhing mngon pa'i pha mtha' gzigs// bdag nyid che las pha rol phyin pa'i tshul// thugs su chud nas bstan pa 'bar mdzad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal de sras mtshungs med pa// ar gyi mtshan can mkhas pa'i grags dkar po// bzang btsun khrir blangs rgyal yum dgongs 'grel bcas// khyod kyis nyin mor mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// khyung gi rigs 'khrungs 'dul ba'i sbyangs pa can// bdag nyid che las dbu tshad bka' babs nas// gangs she rgya dmar sogs kyi bshad pa yi// srol 'byed rin chen grags la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mig gcig blo ldan bzang po yi// chos kyi khri chen mthon po la bzhugs nas// phul byung mdzad pa lhag ma'i khur bzhes pa// zhang tshe spong ba/ chos kyi bla mar grags la phyag 'tshal lo// gang khyod lo tsā ba/ 'jig rten mig las rab byung zhing*// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i gnad rnams thugs chud nas// bdag nyid che la rgyal ba ji bzhin du// dad thob gro lung pa/ blo gros 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal// zab rgyas chos kyi gangs ri la 'khod nas// lung rigs seng ge'i nga ros byang phyogs 'dir// rigs pa'i lam srol dang por 'byed mdzad pa// thos bsam spyan gyis bden pa gzigs khyod ni// rgya gar paṇa chen du ma'i skye ba brgyud// lo chen dbyings su byon lor khyod sku bltams// sgra dang tshad ma'i rig gnas ngang gis mkhyen// 'jigs med phywa par grags la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi bla ma/ zhang tshe nyid las thog mar rab tu byung*// bya 'dul drung du bsnyen par rdzogs mdzad nas// ngur smrig pa'i slob ma dang*/ bya brtson 'grus 'bar/ 'dul ba'i tshogs dang chos mngon rgya mtsho yi// pha rol gzigs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// ne'u'i thog tu zhag rgya dmar sogs la/ 'jig rten mig gcig gi /bshad pa'i srol kun rdzogs par legs sbyangs shing*// khyad par bstan pa'i bdag po gro lung pa'i// bdud rtsi ngoms par gsol la phyag 'tshal lo// dus der gangs can ljongs kyi blo mig can// thams cad khyod zhabs nges par bsten byed cing*// khyad par

karma phag gru sogs/ grub chen gsum dang jo sa rngog khu gnyos/ sras bzhi// seng chen brgyad kyis btegs la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa'i gzhung lugs dgongs 'grel bcas pa dang*// rang rgyud shar ba'i dbu ma rgyan snang bden/ rnam gsum dang*// rnam 'grel mdzad gzhung gsung rab mtha' dag la// lta ba'i mig tu byas la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam sprul rngog lo yi// sras kyi thu bo rnam bzhi'i bshad pa'i srol// lung rigs nyin byed stong gi 'od 'bar bas// gangs can nyin mor mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar bsam pa thag pas yi rang zhing*// de yi legs mdzad nges par brjod pa yis// rmongs pa'i mun chen 'thibs po 'dir bsal nas// lung rigs nyi zla'i 'od stong 'char bar shog /ces bya ba 'di ni rngog lo ts+tsha ba chen po sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dga' ston chen pos/ dad pa'i shing rta nges par drangs pa'i bshes gnyen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas gsol ba btab ba'i ngor bdag nyid chen po de'i lung rigs kyi thur mas/ blo gros kyi mig rab tu gsal bar byas pa'i klog pa pa/ dpal shākya mchog ldan legs pa'i blos khyung tshang gser mdog can gyi dben gnas su nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i bstod pa lha'i rnga dbyangs bzhugs so// ༄// na maḥshākya shrī ye/ me mo lug la sku bltams nas// shing mo bya la gshegs kyi bar// gcig gis ma tshang lo brgyar ni// 'jig rten mgon gang bde bar 'tsho// nyer gsum lon pa sa sbrul la// bsnyen par rdzogs nas don brgyad pa// shing pho byi ba'i lo nyid la// bod yul byon nas 'gro don mdzad// de nas chu mo bya yi bar// bstan pa gsal mdzad lo bcu pa// shing pho khyi la kha cher gshegs// de nas gnyis lhag bcu yi lor// 'khor mang bsdus dang smin pa dang*// grol mdzad sangs rgyas bstan pa yi// nyi ma ches cher gsal bar mdzad// thub dbang gshegs nas lo yi grangs// stong phrag gcig dang drug brgya dang*// dgu bcu rtsa gnyis mthar son tshe// gang 'di ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtsor// 'khrungs 'gyur zhes pa lo tsā bas// mdzad pa'i bstod pa nyid las 'byung*// gang de bsnyen par rdzogs lo las// gzhan du 'khrungs pa'i lor byas na// shing bya dgu bcu rtsa dgu par// 'grig pa'i go skabs ma mchis so// de dang nges par 'grig dgos pa'i// shes byed sil snyan bdun pa las// gcig gis ma tshang lo brgya'i dus// bya lo snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi// spen pa'i nyi ma'i tshes lnga la// 'gro ba'i nyi ma nub ces bshad// 'khrungs lo me mo lug yin pa'i// shes byed paṇa chen rang nyid kyis// me mo yos la thang po cher// bstan rtsis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad las// smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi// tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la// zla ba ri bo la nub tshe// thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das// de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig

/bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang*// zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed// de bzhin nyi ma lnga 'das zhes// gsal bar gsungs pa yin phyir ro// me yos de nas deng sang lo// shing sbrul sna tshogs dbyig 'di'i bar// nyis brgya bdun cu don dgu ste// drug bcu 'khor yug rnam bzhi dang*// sum cu rtsa dgu lon pa ni// gdon mi za ba nyid phyir ro// bstan rtsis rnam gzhag mi mthun pa// mang por gyur kyang de dus kyi// me yos nas ni deng 'di'i bar// 'khrul pa med cing dus de yi// rab byung lo de ma byon pa'i// sangs rgyas gsum pa rang gi lo// brgyad bcu rtsa gcig pa nyid ces// nor 'khrul med par grub pa na// rgyas bshad de dag thams cad pa// 'bad pa med par ngang gis 'char// paṇa chen rang lo re lnga pa// bod du byon pa yin no zhes// rnam thar 'ga' las 'byung mod kyang*// sku tshe'i tshad dang 'grig mi nus// de yang khro phu lo tsā ba// rang lo sum cu rtsa drug pas// paṇa chen bod du spyan drangs shing*// de lo nga dgu lon pa'i tshe// paṇa chen gshegs pa'i gdung ring srel// bod du byon nas de bzhugs pa'i// mchod rten che de bsgrubs so zhes// dpag bsam ljon par grags las gsungs// de skad 'di ni stan gcig pa// 'ga' yis bskul nas paṇa chen la// dad thob mchog ldan legs pa'i blos// sna tshogs dbyig gi lo la sbyar// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
